date_note: Attack was over the weekend before 12 Oct (per Haufe, dated 15 Oct); date is the city's Nov 18 recovery notice.
title: Eichstätt town hall to restore all services on 23 November after weeks-long cyberattack outage
summary: Eichstätt in Bavaria says its administration can offer all services again from Monday 23 November, by appointment, after a multi-week outage of its specialist applications. Servers are running again and building permits work via BayernPortal. In October Haufe reported investigators assumed ransomware and that much city data had been copied; no culprit was named.
plain: A Bavarian town hall that was crippled by hackers for weeks says every service will be back next Monday.
exec: Shows how long a municipal ransomware recovery can take and that backlogs follow.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Residents book registration appointments through the city's booking page.

validation.note: City notice read; Haufe independently reports the attack, ransomware assumption and data copying.
